title: Countries of Southwest Asia
short: Find the countries of Southwest Asia, from Türkiye and the countries of the Caucasus to Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states.
trouble: Students mix up Iran and Iraq, which sit side by side. Iraq is the western, smaller one, between the Tigris and Euphrates; Iran is the larger one to the east.

practice.q: Iran and Iraq are next to each other. Which is the western one?
steps: Iraq is the smaller, western country, where the Tigris and Euphrates flow.
Iran is the larger country to the east; it belongs to the next topic's region.
practice.title: Iran or Iraq?

blocks.html: Asia is the largest continent, with more countries and people than any other. We start in its southwest, where Asia meets Europe and Africa. The UN calls this region Western Asia; it has eighteen countries, and many of them are on the Arabian Peninsula, which you met in Islands and Peninsulas.

blocks.name: gg-map
blocks.cap: The countries of Southwest Asia. Hatching marks areas whose status is disputed.

blocks.html: In the north: Türkiye (Turkey) and the three Caucasus countries, Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, plus the island of Cyprus. In the middle: Syria, Lebanon, Israel, Palestine (a UN observer state), Jordan and Iraq. On the Arabian Peninsula: Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait.

Rivers decided where people settled here. The Tigris and Euphrates flow from the mountains of Türkiye through Syria and Iraq to the Gulf (the Persian Gulf, also called the Arabian Gulf). The land between them, Mesopotamia, was home to some of the world's first cities. The Arabian Peninsula, by contrast, is mostly desert, so its people live along the coasts and at oases.

blocks.title: Iran or Iraq?
blocks.q: Iran and Iraq are next to each other. Which is the western one?
steps: Iraq is the smaller, western country, where the Tigris and Euphrates flow.
Iran is the larger country to the east; it belongs to the next topic's region.

blocks.title: The small Gulf countries
blocks.q: Which country is an island in the Gulf?
steps: Kuwait is at the top of the Gulf, on the mainland.
Bahrain is an island off the coast of Saudi Arabia.

blocks.html: Iran and Iraq differ by one letter and sit side by side. Iraq (ending in q) is the western, smaller one, between the Tigris and Euphrates. Iran (ending in n) is the much larger one to the east, reaching toward Pakistan.
